description: This file defines the PooledBuffer struct, an implementation of IBufferWriter<byte> that manages pooled array segments for efficient buffer management and serialization. It includes methods for writing, copying, enumerating, and slicing buffer data, as well as internal classes for segment pooling and memory management.

classes.name: SequenceSegmentPool
classes.description: A singleton class managing pools of SequenceSegment objects for efficient reuse, including small and large segments.

classes.name: SequenceSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of a sequence, managing its own array and memory, with methods for resizing, committing, and returning to the pool.

methods.name: ToArray
methods.description: Converts the written buffer data into a byte array.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the current write position by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer, returning all segments to the pool and clearing internal state.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Provides a Memory<byte> segment for writing, growing the buffer if necessary.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Provides a Span<byte> for writing, growing the buffer if necessary.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies buffer contents to a provided span, buffer, or buffer writer.

methods.name: AsReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySequence<byte> representing the written data.

methods.name: Slice
methods.description: Returns a BufferSlice representing a portion of the buffer.
